t: A Rajput kingdom in southern Rajasthan ruled by the Guhila and Sisodia dynasty from the early 8th century to 1949.
Its fortress of Chittor fell to Alauddin Khalji, Bahadur Shah and Akbar, and became a symbol of Rajput resistance.
Mewar accepted Mughal overlordship in 1615 and British protection in 1818, joining Rajasthan in 1948–1949.
dyk: The rulers of Mewar governed as the diwan, or chief minister, of the god Ekalinga, whom the dynasty regarded as the true king of the land.
ev: Bappa Rawal traditionally takes Chittor and founds the Guhila kingdom
Alauddin Khalji captures Chittor after an eight-month siege
Rana Sanga is defeated by Babur at the Battle of Khanwa
Udai Singh II founds Udaipur on Lake Pichola
Akbar takes Chittor after a siege of several months
Maharana Pratap fights a Mughal army at the Battle of Haldighati
Amar Singh I accepts Mughal overlordship on honourable terms
Udaipur joins the United State of Rajasthan; Bhupal Singh becomes Rajpramukh

f.capital: Nagda and Ahar; Chittor; Udaipur from 1559
